ListL3Clients.action: This interface is fixed as ListL3Clients
ListL3Clients.marker: Sorted by clientIp in lexicographical order, returns results after marker (excluding marker), defaults to empty string
ListL3Clients.maxKeys: Maximum number of clients to return, defaults to 1000; values ≤ 0 are corrected to 1, values > 1000 are corrected to 1000
